description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for persisting and querying KycRecord entities, specifically providing a method to find KycRecords by passenger ID ordered by creation date descending.

classes.name: KycRecordRepository
classes.description: A repository interface for performing persistence operations on KycRecord entities, extending Spring Data JPA's JpaRepository.

methods.name: findByPassengerIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc
methods.description: Finds a list of KycRecords associated with a specific passenger ID, ordered by creation date descending.
